changelog: A restore or refund of a line whose product was permanently deleted no longer puts its ready-made units on a shelf that can't sell them. WooCommerce loads such a line without its variation id and with the parent product in its place, so the units went to the parent's row, or to row 0 for a simple product. They are now written off, with the reason "N units written off: their product was deleted" and the line's own variation (or product) id in the History. Parts still go back to their shelves. A product that is only in the trash is unchanged: its units go back to it.
The update details popup shows the changelog as plain text, without * emphasis marks.

The nightly report (email and Preview tab) ends a left-behind entry for a slug collision with one full stop. The merge steps now follow the list as a sentence of their own, instead of ending the entry with a full stop that the list's "; " or final "." doubled. The Parts tab and wp stockroom check keep the reason and its steps together, as before.

Plain-text emails keep apostrophes and quotes. The three plain templates escaped their text for HTML, and WooCommerce's plain-text clean-up deletes ', so a part labelled Philly's arrived as "Phillys" and the slug-collision reason as "Its terms slug". They now print the text with tags stripped and entities decoded (BaseEmail::plain()).

The help under "Backorders on managed variations" names no version: "Variations Stockroom has managed start at "Do not allow": allow backorders on each one that should take them." In English and French.

Stockroom in Canadian French, every string (419 of 419): the admin screens, settings, emails, order notes, WP-CLI, and the cart and checkout messages shoppers see. Typography after the Office québécois de la langue française, the same in every string; WooCommerce's fields and choices quoted as WooCommerce's own fr_CA translation shows them. The admin script's strings ship as JSON. A unit test fails when a string in the POT has no French.
composer i18n:compile builds the .mo, .l10n.php and script JSON from the .po.
The admin smoke test checks the "Parts owed to orders" and "Shortages" notices with axe.
